lines: Another evening on the bike. Same wall, same numbers, same thirty minutes.
The bike is smart. It just never gives you a reason to come back tomorrow.
Meet Telo Ride. It turns your smart bike at home into a game.
One press pairs it over Bluetooth. Telo Ride reads your power, and sets the resistance for every hill and interval.
It runs in Chrome or Edge, on a phone, a tablet or a desktop.
Pair once, and it remembers your bike.
Next comes Race. Ride a map against the ghost of your best time, a pack of bots, or other riders.
Then Classes. Ride along to a video, alone or with a group.
Both feed one progression: XP, rider levels, stars, and map unlocks.
And for your own intervals, a custom workout, under Profile.
